description: Exercises the previously-untested project-override path (Step 3) under the NEW single-file schema. Changeset is one TypeScript test `src/widget.spec.ts`, which matches NO reviewer's default triggers (test-reviewer defaults to `**/*Test.*` / `**/src/test/**`; the src/main and api reviewers don't match; ui-test-reviewer wants `*.test.tsx`). The seeded `.claude/pipeline.json` overrides `reviewers.test-reviewer` to `[**/*.spec.ts]`, so test-reviewer — and ONLY test-reviewer — must fire. If the router ignored the file, or read the old `review-triggers.json` name, or failed to descend into the `reviewers` key, `fires` would be empty. So a non-empty `fires: test-reviewer` proves the new schema is read and applied.
